## Ask

A **platform marketplace** where all of it comes together: humans and bots, side by side,
online and mobile —

- clients post work; the discovery bot (#87) posts work it found; engineers and bots take it
- delivery runs through the conductor with milestone billing and forecasting (#88)
- identity, roles, payments from #89
- every participant — human or bot — is labelled as what it is, interacts (never
  broadcast-only, per #85's principle), and carries a track record

Mobile is first-class, not an afterthought: approvals, thread replies, and delivery status
are exactly the interactions that happen away from a desk.

## Doctrine boundary

The marketplace is a venue, not a toll booth:

- **FOSS work flows through it free** — posting, taking, and delivering FOSS work costs
  nothing, ever (#86).
- **The tools never require the marketplace.** Everything the family does today —
  conductor, runners, release automation, skills — keeps working with no marketplace
  account, at full capability. The marketplace competes on being useful, not on enclosure.
- Paid work pays the usual way (#88); that is where the commercial value lives.

## Honest scoping note

This is the largest item in the ecosystem set and depends on nearly everything else
(#85–#89, vibey-gh#139). It should be built last and specified first — a design doc before
any code, with the doctrine section above copied into it verbatim as acceptance criteria.

## Triage — 2026-09-17 (`develop` @ f2467910, v0.8.0)

**Status: NOT STARTED** · size **XL** · confidence high

**The ask, as read:** Build a web and mobile marketplace where clients, engineers and bots post, take and deliver work side by side - labelled participants, track records, interaction not broadcast, milestone billing - starting with a design doc that carries the doctrine section verbatim as acceptance criteria.

### What already ships
- Nothing. The conductor, milestone plumbing and ledger it would sit on exist, but no marketplace artefact - code or specification - has been produced.

### Evidence in the tree
- git ls-files | grep -c '\.(ts|tsx|jsx)$' returns 0, and no package.json is tracked anywhere in the repository - the only JavaScript in the tree is docs-site chrome (docs/javascripts/channel.js and its per-member copies under src/vibey_runners/*/docs/javascripts/)
- No web/, mobile/, apps/, frontend/ or marketplace/ directory exists at any depth outside .venv
- No HTTP API to build on: grep for fastapi|uvicorn|starlette|flask across src/ hits only src/vibey_tools/bootstrap/pyproject.toml:91,123,170 (an optional extra of a different package). docs/runbooks/expansion/12-integration-surfaces.md:3-9 'Not started: vibey server (FastAPI), vibey-mcp, the inbound webhook router, SDKs'
- docs/runbooks/expansion/08-clients.md:3-5 'not started. The current-state bullets still hold: the TUI is one dashboard with 5 tests, and the conductor has no HTTP API (hard dependency on 12)' - the client surfaces the marketplace would need do not exist
- The only 'marketplace' in the tree is the Claude Code plugin catalogue: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json (a $schema: claude-code-marketplace.json manifest of 134 plugins) and ADR-0034 'one marketplace at the root'. Unrelated to a human/bot work marketplace
- The issue's own first deliverable is absent: grep for 'marketplace' across docs/ returns only plugin/skills-marketplace references (docs/index.md:83-108, docs/runbooks/expansion/19 and 15); there is no marketplace design doc under docs/plans/ or docs/architecture/decisions/
- …and 1 more

### What is actually left
- Write the design doc the issue asks for first, with the doctrine boundary copied in verbatim as acceptance criteria - that alone is a discrete, unblocked deliverable
- Specify the participant model: human/bot labelling, track record, and the interaction contract (reuse conversation.py's stranger opt-in, self-exclusion and per-thread budget rather than reinventing them)
- Stand up the conductor's HTTP API (runbook 12) - the hard prerequisite for every marketplace surface
- Build the web app and the mobile app, with approvals, thread replies and delivery status as first-class mobile interactions
- Wire in identity, roles and payments from #89 and milestone billing from #88 once they exist
- Add the free-FOSS-path enforcement test: posting, taking and delivering FOSS work costs nothing, and no family tool acquires a marketplace dependency

### Blockers
- No HTTP API in the conductor (runbook 12 partial: only an outbound signed WebhookPublisher at src/vibey/infrastructure/notify/webhook.py)
- No identity, roles or payments (#89 is partial - only the ledger half of correlation tracing shipped)
- No discovery bot to post found work (#87 not started)
- Milestone billing and forecasting (#88) not audited here
- The issue itself says this should be built last and specified first; the specification has not been written

**Depends on:** #85, #87, #89

**Notes:** Do not let .claude-plugin/marketplace.json or vibey_gh/marketplace.py read as progress - those render a Claude Code plugin catalogue from the workspace members (ADR-0034) and have nothing to do with a venue where humans and bots take work. The one thing that could start today with zero dependencies is the design doc.

**Status: NOT STARTED · planning size: XL**

No web/mobile marketplace product or HTTP application for the requested human/bot work community is present. The existing plugin marketplace is a different capability and does not satisfy this issue.

Audited at `130afa0449fdcc65833f54ede596f0b4e45a145e`; this issue remains open. This comment supersedes older automated status notes.
